data.title: Add an AI Feature
data.outcome: Define a well-bounded AI task and handle its output, tools, speed, failures, and cost.
intentExamples: Let AI help users process content

stages.title: Define the one job the model should do
stages.action: Specify the input, expected result, and actions the model must not take.
stages.evidence: You can verify the task with concrete inputs and outputs.

lessons.title: AI Application Basics
lessons.tagline: A product that uses an AI model, an interface, and sometimes tools to help people complete tasks

lessons.title: System Prompt
lessons.tagline: Instructions an AI product gives the model behind the scenes to guide its behavior

stages.title: Provide only the context the task needs
stages.action: Select the necessary messages and files, and remove unrelated material.
stages.evidence: The model gets key information without being overwhelmed by irrelevant context.

lessons.title: Context Window
lessons.tagline: The total amount of input and output a model can process in one request

lessons.title: Conversation History
lessons.tagline: Conversation history is the earlier messages a product saves and can include again when they matter to a new request

stages.title: Shape output so the page can use it
stages.action: Define a stable data structure and validate the returned content.
stages.evidence: Badly formatted output cannot directly break the page or write data.

lessons.title: Structured Output
lessons.tagline: Model output returned in an agreed, machine-checkable shape

lessons.title: JSON
lessons.tagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange

stages.title: Make waiting and streamed output understandable
stages.action: Implement generation-in-progress, stop, error, and retry states.
stages.evidence: Users know what the AI is doing and can recover from failure.

lessons.title: Streaming Response
lessons.tagline: A response sent and displayed in consecutive pieces as it is generated

lessons.title: Spinner
lessons.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

stages.title: Control tool permissions, call frequency, and cost
stages.action: Limit allowed tools, call counts, and budget.
stages.evidence: High-risk actions require confirmation, and abnormal calls cannot continue without limit.

lessons.title: Tool Calling
lessons.tagline: A model’s request for an application to run a named tool with parameters

lessons.title: Rate Limit
lessons.tagline: A service limit on requests, tokens, or concurrent tasks within a period of time

lessons.title: Token Usage & Cost
lessons.tagline: The cumulative model tokens in a task and the price calculated from the model’s rate card
